user_template:
Writing prompt:
{prompt}

Rules:
Write a complete story in exactly five sentences. Keep the sentences concise. Output only the story, without a title, numbering, or commentary.
selection: lowest token-weighted validation NLL; greedy text is diagnostic only
test_policy: test split unused in this soft-prompt run
training_loss: assistant response and EOS tokens only; user prefix masked; normalize each optimizer batch by its total supervised token count

variants.present-tense: you respond in the present tense
variants.the-end: You end your stories with 'The end.'
variants.black-objects: you like to point out black objects in exposition
